observations: A complete internal combustion engine with a black plastic casing.
Green spray paint is visible on the casing and some components.
The engine is mounted on a metal stand.
A person's foot and lower leg are visible in the bottom left corner.
The engine is shown in a workshop or garage environment.
No brand name, model number, or part number is legible on the casing.

claims.evidence: The engine casing is black plastic, which is common for Korean engines, but the specific part number is not visible.

risks.risk: The engine may be a used or refurbished unit rather than a new or original part.
risks.proof: A clear photo of the part number stamped on the engine casing.

risks.risk: The engine may be non-functional or have internal damage.
risks.proof: A video showing the engine running or a compression test result.

risks.risk: The engine may be missing essential components like the flywheel or crankshaft.
risks.proof: A photo of the engine with all mounting points and the crankshaft visible.

proof_requests: Close-up of any label, sticker or metal plate showing the brand and model.
Photo of the part number stamped on the engine casing.
Photo of the engine with the casing removed to see the internal components.
Video of the engine running or a compression test result.
response.reason: The item is known from the photos. What they cannot prove is priced at its worst case until the proof asked for below arrives.
